# Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta1

This beta makes the visible mowing trail follow the mower family's cutting width instead of drawing every model with the same 25 cm route.

## Changed

- The rendered mowing swath is now **confirmed cutting width + 10 cm total visual tolerance** (5 cm on each side of the route centreline).
- **X4:** 43 cm cutting width -> 53 cm rendered trail.
- **X3:** 23.7 cm cutting width -> 33.7 cm rendered trail.
- **H-series:** 21 cm cutting width -> 31 cm rendered trail.
- **i1-series:** 18 cm cutting width -> 28 cm rendered trail.
- Unknown/unmapped models keep the previous 25 cm rendered width.
- The same model-aware width is used for the live trail, retained/history trails, and the selected-session pulse highlight.

The extra 5 cm per side is display tolerance only. It does not change mower data, route coordinates, coverage, or history semantics.
